productArea.name: Repository discovery
productArea.scope: Find repositories through Explore, dashboard, user, and organization inventories using search, visibility and topic filters, sorting, pagination, and repository cards. Opening a repository checks navigation only, leaving its features, creation, and account repository settings to their own areas.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Explore then Repositories and use its search, filters, sorting, and pagination.
Use the signed-in dashboard repository inventory and its search and filters.
Open the fixture user profile and inspect its repository inventory.
Choose an accessible organization and inspect its repository inventory and dashboard. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
